resolvedBugs.title: Hero height divergence across page families on desktop and tablet
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Individual page templates had conflicting scoped CSS with ad-hoc padding and min-height rules.
resolvedBugs.fix: Consolidated all 26 inner pages to src/components/hero/PageHero.astro bound to shared tokens in tokens.css.

resolvedBugs.title: Homepage Section 7 unrequested decorative column icon
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Leftover decorative column icon in 'What to Prepare Before You Begin' section.
resolvedBugs.fix: Surgically removed unwanted decorative icon and rebalanced padding and grid layout.

resolvedBugs.title: Generic WhatsApp enquiries lacked page, section, and service context
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Hardcoded WhatsApp URLs across templates without dynamic context parameters.
resolvedBugs.fix: Standardized all buttons via src/utils/whatsapp.ts with automated context prefilling to 919048188899.

resolvedBugs.title: Localhost URLs in canonical and Open Graph metadata
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Default Astro site parameter unset during local preview builds.
resolvedBugs.fix: Hardcoded canonical domain https://brndnur.com/ across BaseLayout.astro and all page templates.

resolvedBugs.title: Missing trailing slashes causing redirect hops on Hostinger static hosting
resolvedBugs.fix: Audited all 234 routes; verified 0 broken links and uniform trailing-slash canonical URLs.

resolvedBugs.title: Missing skip-to-content links and landmarks on standalone pages
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Some utility pages omitted the skip-link navigation component.
resolvedBugs.fix: Centralized skip-link in BaseLayout.astro wrapping all 234 static routes.

resolvedBugs.title: Missing HTTP security headers on static hosting
resolvedBugs.rootCause: Static web servers do not automatically apply security headers without .htaccess.
resolvedBugs.fix: Configured public/.htaccess with HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
